title: Physics-informed random neural architectures on compact boundaryless multiply connected manifolds for random-operator models in machine learning and uncertainty quantification
abstract: arXiv:2610.14844v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce stochastic physics-informed neural networks (SPINNs) for stochastic boundary-value problems (SBVPs) with random operators. The method enforces physics through a structural probabilistic coupling: a common Gaussian stochastic germ drives both the SBVP random operator and a manifold-based stochastic neural architecture. The stochastic neural network is non-feedforward and intrinsically random. A latent Gaussian field and an inhomogeneous Poisson point process on a compact, boundaryless, multiply connected manifold generate random neuron locations, geodesically local sparse connectivity, and a sparse random weight matrix, all governed by a low-dimensional hyperparameter. For deterministic inputs, the network output is random and can represent non-Gaussian random operators. Training is performed in observation space: SBVP simulations produce random observables, while the SNN defines a predictive conditional probability density f

translated_title: 用于机器学习与不确定性量化中随机算子模型的紧致无边多连通流形上的物理信息随机神经架构
translated_abstract: 我们提出了针对具有随机算子的随机边值问题（SBVPs）的随机物理信息神经网络（SPINNs）。该方法通过一种结构化概率耦合来施加物理约束：一个共同的高斯随机源同时驱动SBVP随机算子和基于流形的随机神经架构。该随机神经网络是非前馈的且本质上随机。在一个紧致、无边、多连通的流形上，一个潜在高斯场和一个非齐次泊松点过程生成随机的神经元位置、测地局部稀疏连接以及稀疏随机权重矩阵，所有这些都由一个低维超参数控制。对于确定性输入，网络输出是随机的，并且能够表示非高斯随机算子。训练在观测空间中进行：SBVP模拟产生随机观测量，而SNN定义一个预测性条件概率密度。
tldr: 本文提出随机物理信息神经网络（SPINNs），通过一个共同的高斯随机源将随机边值问题的随机算子与构建在紧致无边多连通流形上的非前馈随机神经网络进行结构化概率耦合，从而能够表示非高斯随机算子并在观测空间中实现不确定性量化。
